prompt: Which North Atlantic tropical storm, whose peak intensity remained at tropical storm level, caused the highest number of deaths last year?
answer: Tropical Storm **Chantal (2025)** caused the most deaths among 2025 North Atlantic storms that never intensified beyond tropical-storm strength, with **two reported fatalities**.
